criteria.automated_scope: No keyword test is used as proof of audit quality. Exact-base findings, dependency scope, retained strengths, priorities and limits are reviewed in the versioned analysis.
Mandatory entry routes are checked. Stable rule meaning, applicability, dynamic/Canvas/generated exceptions and the distinction between automatic/review/legacy obligations require substantive review.

Actual code-path and bilingual contexts resolve the guide and commands through fresh RI. Tests reject missing owned-control coverage and stale mapped source. Current CI mapping verifies unconditional invocations; templates/AGENTS retain mandatory routes.

The actual repository guard and independent fixture mutations cover canonical token owners, authored HTML inline styles, scoped literal imports, active-source placement/coverage and exact frozen debt. This proves the declared subset, not general formatting, semantic architecture, full JS dependency analysis or speed.

The plan is reviewed for source owners, priorities, dependencies, parity contracts, scope limits and measurable done conditions. Tests cannot certify the quality or execution of future architectural work.

Basic and current RI/CI checks establish local source contracts. Live Draft/commit/CI links, actual checkboxes, unchanged runtime/content/public diff and truthful review status are external evidence. Merge and broad refactor execution are not supplied by this policy.

G01.description: Review the source-grounded audit, separate guide and ordered Sol plan against original intent. Record reviewer role and findings honestly: primary-agent self-review is not independent review or maintainer approval. Verify source/generated/history distinctions, practical rules/exceptions, target ownership, phased parity tests and unchanged visual/content/release contracts.

G02.description: Record the actual Draft PR, exact commit/tree and current required CI runs; verify the diff contains no site runtime/content/public changes; reconcile actual issue checkboxes and review status. Draft delivery does not authorize merge, production or future broad refactor implementation.
